name: chat_send_message
description: Send a user message to an existing session and receive the full assistant reply synchronously (non-streaming fallback). Internally runs the full LangGraph RAG pipeline: metadata extraction → multi-query translation → hybrid Qdrant search (dense + sparse + RRF) → relevance grading → generation → groundedness check. Persists both the user message and the assistant reply to PostgreSQL. Prefer the WebSocket endpoint for real-time streaming in production UI.

content.description: User message text, e.g. 'What Python backend roles match my experience?'
